description: Event-driven order fulfillment using Azure Service Bus topics, compensating saga orchestration in Azure Functions or Durable Functions, idempotent consumers, and dead-letter monitoring with operational dashboards for poison-message recovery.
constraints: Compensating transactions for partial saga failure
No synchronous cross-domain coupling in the hot path
Dead-letter queues monitored with SLA alerts
requiredCapabilities: Azure Cosmos DB or SQL for saga state
Azure Key Vault for connection secrets
assumptions: Peak 500 events per second with burst to 2k
Ordering required only within aggregate partition key
